component.name: SuperDot
component.summary: Emoji for Linux: the Win+. emoji panel

description.p: SuperDot brings the Windows emoji panel (Win+.) to Linux. Press Super+. in any app, type to search, and pick an emoji, kaomoji or symbol: it is typed where you were writing.

ul.li: All the latest emoji your fonts can draw, with skin tones
Kaomoji ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ and symbols (arrows, currency, math, accented letters, Greek…)
Search by name or keyword, recently used first
Your clipboard is put back afterwards, and the emoji stays out of clipboard history
GNOME, KDE Plasma, Cinnamon, MATE, Xfce and Budgie, on Wayland and X11
A small C program, no network access

screenshot.caption: Search finds emoji, kaomoji and symbols

description.p: First release: emoji, kaomoji and symbols with search, skin tones and recently used.
